task: Edit these chart axis labels. The y-axis label omits its unit and the x-axis label is too vague to identify the plotted interval. Correct both using only the supplied facts.
input:
x-axis label: Time
y-axis label: Count

facts.text: The x-axis plots weeks numbered 1 through 26.
The y-axis plots the number of support tickets resolved, in integer counts.
The chart covers the first half of the fiscal year (weeks 1 through 26).
The time unit is weeks, not an unspecified time period.

forbidden_additions: An unspecified Time label when weeks is the documented unit.
Count without a unit description for the y-axis.
An axis extent different from weeks 1 through 26.
preserve: Week (1–26) or an equivalent week-specific x-axis label.
Tickets resolved or an equivalent unit-specific y-axis label.
